title: Bad Client
description: A modpack that focuses on making Minecraft unplayable while remaining completely client-side.
body:
_Bad client_ is a Minecraft client that focuses on making Minecraft unplayable while remaining completely client-side

This modpack is for content creators or people looking for an interesting gameplay experience


<details>
<summary>Our modpack adds:</summary>

- Cursed shaders

- Cursed resource packs

- Custom menu

- Basic optimalization mods

- Premade options

</details>
